## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml` (for backend changes)
- [ ] macOS checked, or not applicable
- [ ] Windows checked, or not applicable

## UI and safety

- [ ] User-visible copy is available in Simplified Chinese and English.
- [ ] No credentials, private paths, logs, dependencies, or build output are included.
- [ ] Process-management changes never terminate an unverified process.
